purpose: Independent literature ground truth for the drug-likeness rule panel implemented in app/tools/admet.py (MATRIX 4). Values are the published threshold constants, not BioNexus's values.

lipinski.citation: Lipinski CA et al., Adv. Drug Deliv. Rev. 1997;23:3-25. 'Rule of Five'
lipinski.note: MW and LogP are to be over, not equal-or-over, the limit to count a violation (published: 'no more than one violation'), i.e. pass if violations <= 1. MW >= 500 and > 500 differ; the code flags '> 500' strictly. HBA counts in the original (Lipinski 1997) are sum of N and O atom count.

veber.citation: Veber DF et al., J. Med. Chem. 2002;45:2615-2623. Oral bioavailability
veber.note: Published cut-offs: TPSA <= 140 A^2 and <= 10 rotatable bonds jointly for good oral bioavailability.

ghose.citation: Ghose AK et al., J. Comb. Chem. 1999;1:55-68. 'Drug-like' property ranges

egan.citation: Egan WJ et al., J. Med. Chem. 2000;43:3867-3877. Oral drug absorption (EPSA / ALOGPS)
egan.note: Egg surface line: logP - 0.008*PSA <= 4.03 equivalent form; the simple box TPSA<=132 and LogP<=5.88 is the widely used approximation.

muegge.citation: Muegge I et al., J. Med. Chem. 2001;44:1841-1846. Global drug-like filter (Bayer)
muegge.note: Plus the published pharmacophore point requirements (e.g. one of: amine, amide, hydroxyl, carboxyl, heteroaromatic) — not checkable here via simple counts; documented as scope limitation.

mddr.citation: Oprea TI et al., J. Comb. Chem. 2000;2:157-166. MDDR drug-like rules

pains.citation: Baell JB, Holloway GA. J. Med. Chem. 2010;53:2719-2740. PAINS (Pan-Assay Interference Compounds) alerts
pains.note: Full PAINS A/B/C catalog (480 SMARTS) is in RDKit FilterCatalog. admet.py implements an 8-pattern subset; scope limitation: subset, not full catalog.

brenk.citation: Brenk R et al., ChemMedChem 2008;3:435-444. Structural alerts for lead-like screening
brenk.note: admet.py implements a 6-rule subset of Brenk's ~105 alerts; scope limitation: subset.
